qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P0-005 internal Chinese reference translations against the official Arabic governing text, using the official English only as secondary guidance. Checks: legal-meaning preservation, terminology, entity/authority roles, obligations/rights, conditions/exceptions/deadlines, scope boundaries, and Bab context (Bab 7 = non-profit company, Bab 9 = holding/subsidiary, Bab 10 = company conversion, Bab 13 = violations/penalties, Bab 14 = final provisions). Review only — no Chinese text or remediation data was modified. Hashes/references only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
